influence.label: Influence
influence.description: Political sway over city-states, councils, and noble families
influence.ceilingDeath: You became too powerful. A coalition of rivals conspired against you — your body was found in the Arno at dawn.
influence.floorExile: Your name carries no weight. The council voted unanimously for your exile — you left Florence with nothing but the clothes on your back.

militaryPower.label: Military power
militaryPower.description: Command of armies, condottieri, and fortifications
militaryPower.ceilingDeath: Your armies grew too large. Venice, Milan, and the Pope formed a league against you. Outnumbered ten to one, your final battle lasted three hours.
militaryPower.floorExile: Without a single soldier to your name, you were defenseless. A minor lord's mercenaries seized your lands while you slept. You fled in the night.

wealth.label: Wealth
wealth.description: Banking capital, trade income, and patronage funds
wealth.ceilingDeath: Your fortune drew every schemer in Italy. They came not with swords but with smiles — and poison. Your heirs found your ledgers doctored and your vaults empty.
wealth.floorExile: Bankrupt and abandoned by every ally who once feasted at your table. Your creditors divided your estates. You died in a Roman boarding house, unrecognized.

churchStanding.label: Church standing
churchStanding.description: Favor with the papacy and clergy
churchStanding.ceilingDeath: The Pope declared you a living saint — which made you a threat to every cardinal who wasn't. They arranged a quiet audience with an apothecary's special wine.
churchStanding.floorExile: Excommunicated. The bell tolled, the book closed, the candle was snuffed. No Christian prince would shelter you. You wandered the edges of Christendom, a ghost.

bands.label: Dramatic
bands.description: Fortuna spins her wheel with force
